articles.summary: Evotec SE and Plectonic Biotech today announced a research collaboration to explore a novel immunotherapy approach for solid tumors. The collaboration addresses key challenges that have so far limited the successful application of traditional T cell engager therapies in solid tumors by combining Plectonic’s programmable LOGIBODY® technology with Evotec’s proprietary BiTco platform. articles.summary: Evotec SE today announced the initiation of a Phase 1 clinical trial evaluating JST-018, a cocktail of investigational monoclonal antibodies targeting orthopoxviruses, developed by its biologics CDMO subsidiary Just – Evotec Biologics under the U.S. Department of War’s Accelerated Antibodies Program.
